# Security Policy

@packstub/holler runs in the browser: it opens the camera, microphone and screen, and connects them to other people's browsers. Please report anything that starts a call, answers one or shares a screen without the person clicking, keeps a camera or microphone on after a call ends, sends media to someone who is not in the call, or lets a crafted signal (an offer, answer, ICE candidate or state message) run script in the page or take over the widget.

If you discover a security issue, email [security@packstub.dev](mailto:security@packstub.dev) instead of using the issue tracker. We answer within a few days and credit reporters in the changelog unless they prefer otherwise.

Who may call whom, and the signaling routes, belong to [Holler for Laravel](https://github.com/packstub/holler), and the Filament panel side to [Filament Holler](https://github.com/packstub/filament-holler); their policies cover them.
